title: Creators' FAQ
subtitle: Here are some of our most frequently asked questions.

faqs.question: What is Huerray?
faqs.answer: Huerray is a UGC platform connecting brands with diverse creators, focusing on authentic storytelling, cultural relevance, and meaningful representation, especially for People of Color and underrepresented voices in the DACH region.

faqs.question: Do I need to post the content on my own social media channels?
faqs.answer: No. You create the content for the brand; publishing on your own channels is not required unless it is explicitly part of the campaign offer.

faqs.question: How do I apply for campaigns?
faqs.answer: Complete your creator profile and browse available campaigns that match your style. Apply directly if you're interested. The brand reviews applications and selects creators. Once you accept the assignment, production begins.

faqs.question: What happens after I’m selected?
faqs.answer: You’ll receive full briefing details. If needed, the client sends production materials. You then create and upload the content through the Huerray platform.

faqs.question: Where do I upload my final content?
faqs.answer: Upload your content in the designated delivery slot within the 'Delivery' section of your campaign. For extra footage, use the 'Additional delivery' button.

faqs.question: What if a brand requests an additional video during an active campaign?
faqs.answer: Contact Huerray via email. They will set up a campaign upgrade so the additional video can be processed and compensated.

faqs.question: What if I’m unavailable or on holiday?
faqs.answer: Activate Vacation Mode and set your unavailable period, or email Huerray to pause your account. You may also mention availability in applications. Key: communicate early.

faqs.question: Can I do this part-time?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many creators work with Huerray alongside jobs or studies. Your workload depends on your availability and workflow efficiency.

faqs.question: Do I need professional equipment?
faqs.answer: Professional gear is not required, but recommended tools include a tripod, microphone, and ring light.

faqs.question: What camera settings should I use?
faqs.answer: Use your smartphone. Record in 4K, check exposure, and clean the lens before filming.

faqs.question: How much time do I have to deliver the content?
faqs.answer: Standard delivery is 7 calendar days from receiving all assets and clarifications. Contact Huerray before the deadline if more time is needed.

faqs.question: Can brands request revisions?
faqs.answer: Yes. One revision round is included per campaign, provided feedback is given within 10 days and remains within the briefing scope.

faqs.question: How much do I earn per campaign?
faqs.answer: Your fee is shown before applying. Additional deliverables or services can be offered as paid upgrades, subject to brand approval.

faqs.question: When do I get paid?
faqs.answer: Payment is triggered once content is approved. Huerray processes the payment and issues an invoice for you. Once your balance reaches €50, payment is transferred within 14 days.

faqs.question: Who owns the content I create?
faqs.answer: Upon approval and payment, usage rights transfer to Huerray for exclusive commercial use, including digital, print, OOH advertising, and AI training. You may not reuse or publish the content unless explicitly permitted.

faqs.question: What if I receive products from the brand?
faqs.answer: Products provided for UGC creation remain the property of Huerray unless explicitly stated otherwise. They must be returned upon request.

faqs.question: Can I work with the brand outside of Huerray?
faqs.answer: No. Direct collaboration outside Huerray is prohibited for 3 months after campaign completion. Violations may lead to account suspension or penalties.

faqs.question: What are my responsibilities as a Creator?
faqs.answer: You must ensure all content is original, non-infringing, consented by third parties visible, free of harmful or illegal material, and fully aligned with campaign guidelines.

faqs.question: I can't access my account – what should I do?
faqs.answer: Click 'Reset password' on the login page. If problems persist, email Huerray support for assistance.

faqs.question: Still have questions?
faqs.answer: Email support@huerray.com for immediate assistance.
